Rishi Sunak Warns Against Defining Britishness by Skin Colour

British Prime Minister Rishi Sunak has cautioned against defining British identity based on skin color. He referenced the "Tebbit test," which questioned loyalty based on ancestry, and shared his personal experience of being identified as "Brown Hindu" and British. Sunak's remarks address the intersection of race, identity, and immigration in the UK.
